settings.heading: Cooler home. Lower bills. Cleaner air.
settings.subheading: Solar panels, solar-powered attic fans, radiant barriers and Critter Guard bird & pest protection — engineered for Utah roofs.

settings.heading: Pull the heat out. Keep the cool in.
settings.body: Our solar attic fans run entirely off the sun — no electrician, no wiring into your panel, no added utility cost. They pull hot, moist air out of your attic, reducing mold risk in winter and cooling your living space in summer.
settings.list_items:
100% solar powered — zero electricity cost
Temps up to 70°F reduced to a cooler attic
Reduces moisture & mold risk year-round
Quiet brushless DC motor, rated for years of use

settings.heading: Own your power, not just your home.
settings.body: Full rooftop solar installations sized to your household's usage, installed by our local crew and backed by a 10-year warranty on workmanship.
settings.list_items:
Custom-designed system sizing
Low-profile, one-way vented mounting
10-year installation warranty
Works alongside Critter Guard protection

settings.heading: Birds, pigeons & pests love the shade under your panels.
settings.body: The gap beneath solar panels is a perfect, sheltered nesting spot — and what moves in causes real damage: droppings that stain and corrode, nesting debris that's a fire risk, and costly repairs to reach.
settings.list_items:
Droppings damage panels & void warranties
Nesting material is a fire hazard
Pest removal and cleanup gets expensive fast

settings.heading: Total exclusion. Zero maintenance.
settings.body: Critter Guard is a low-profile, rust-resistant 1/2-inch mesh that clips directly to your panel frame — keeping birds, pigeons and rodents out for good, without being visible from the ground.
settings.list_items:
1/2" mesh keeps everything out
Clips to frame, no roof penetration
Discreet, low-profile design
10-year warranty included
